statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-48978 lets a malicious OCI registry redirect the oras-go auth client's Bearer-challenge realm to exfiltrate the caller's registry credentials and refresh tokens in cleartext. oras-go v1 is reached only through Helm's OCI registry client, which the console constructs with no authentication (pkg/helm/actions GetOCIRegistry sets no credentials): its chart pulls are anonymous, so the credential-bearing token exchange the advisory hijacks is never performed and there is no stored secret for a rogue realm to leak. The issue is LOW severity (CVSS 2.1) with no fixed oras-go v1 release; the separately-vendored oras-go v2 module carries the fix and is pinned to 2.6.2 here.

CVE-2026-48978 lets a malicious OCI registry redirect the oras-go auth client's Bearer-challenge realm to exfiltrate the caller's registry credentials and refresh tokens in cleartext. oras-go v1 is reached only through Helm's OCI registry client, which the console constructs with no authentication (pkg/helm/actions GetOCIRegistry sets no credentials): its chart pulls are anonymous, so the credential-bearing token exchange the advisory hijacks is never performed and there is no stored secret for a rogue realm to leak. The issue is LOW severity (CVSS 2.1) with no fixed oras-go v1 release; the separately-vendored oras-go v2 module carries the fix and is pinned to 2.6.2 here.

The advisory covers auth.Client bearer-realm handling in registry/remote/auth/client.go (Client.Do, Client.fetchBearerToken, fetchDistributionToken, fetchOAuth2Token), fixed in oras-go 2.6.1. That package tree does not exist in the v1 module line: oras.land/oras-go v1.2.5 ships only pkg/**, and the devfile-gem Go binary links pkg/oras, pkg/auth/docker, pkg/content, pkg/artifact and pkg/target. The vulnerable code is absent.
